finding: Multiple TotalEnergies Morocco 22 kW AC charging sites in the official TotalEnergies network are independently listed by Atlas Recharge as operated by Kilowatt. This materially strengthens, but does not by itself prove, the hypothesis that the TotalEnergies Al Waha 22 kW AC charger visible in the Kilowatt app is Kilowatt-operated rather than merely roaming-accessible.

modeling.rule: Keep site_brand, CPO/operator, app_source/access_network and tariff_channel separate. Do not promote Al Waha to confirmed CPO=Kilowatt until a direct operator/backend/source attribution is obtained.

official_totalenergies_evidence.source: TotalEnergies Marketing Maroc - Energie Renouvelable / Notre réseau de bornes de recharges électriques

interpretation.reason: The same official TotalEnergies network contains several 22 kW AC sites that an independent Morocco EV directory explicitly attributes to Kilowatt. Al Waha has the same 22 kW AC official-site pattern and is directly visible in the Kilowatt app, while it was not visible in the user's TotalEnergies Club EV-Charge app check.
